title: Setup: a point-anchored violation is named though a general is missing
rationale: Two clauses are broken here — the advisor stands off its five points and Red has no general — and the one that names a point is the one reported. That is the order the clauses are stated in: what a report is for is telling a composer what to fix next, and a point is what a composer points at. It is also why a position may be judged from its first piece onward, before either general is on the board.
